transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Um... I guess I just haven't been doing great. I keep feeling like... like I've let my family down by taking on this mortgage. And... I don't know. Every small mistake I make at work, it just feels like it proves I'm useless. Like I deserve whatever happens to me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless most of the time recently?

Yeah... I guess so. Most days, there's just this... heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I just go through the motions at work. You know, carrying plates, smiling at tables because I'm supposed to... not because I actually feel anything good. So... yeah.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling?
Um... it's been a while. I guess maybe... a year and two months? Give or take. That's how long I've been feeling this down, anyway... and just guilty about everything.
Before this started about a year ago, had you ever experienced another time in your life when you felt depressed like this?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've ever felt quite like this before... just since last year.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
No... I don't think so. I've never really felt wired, or... on top of the world. Not that I can remember, anyway.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things that you used to enjoy?
Um... yeah, I guess. I don't really do much anymore. Just... don't feel like it.
How has your sleep been lately?
Um... it's been okay, I guess. Nothing really different.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy lately?
No... not really. Just the usual, I suppose.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um... I guess my eating's been kind of all over the place. Like, some weeks at work I barely touch the staff meal. But then... other nights I'll get home and just eat whatever's in the kitchen. Just trying to feel settled, I guess.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions lately?

Um... yeah, a little. It's just... at work, keeping the numbers straight on the POS system and the inventory sheets. It's been harder. I'll just stand there staring at the screen... I know I've done it a million times, but I just... I don't trust what I just punched in.
Have you had any thoughts of wishing you were dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No... I mean, I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. I wouldn't do that. 

It's just... I don't know. Sometimes, when I'm lying awake before an early shift, I just kind of think... maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. Just so I wouldn't have to keep... failing at everything. But... yeah. I'm not going to actually do anything.
